notes.title: Major Update to the UI!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36336199/028a7345db53f484ef898b1462cd123fd1650841.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36336199/f65d1a2386e85552e30e65fa7709a96661af206e.png[/img][/url]Your voices have been heard!

There has been a ton of changes to the UI! Here is what has been changed:

A cool effect has been added when you are at a selection in the menu.

New Settings option in the menu you with the following additions:

-You can now toggle sound on and off, and music on and off.
-You can turn fullscreen on and off.

In the controls section, you can now customize your controls for both the keyboard and the gamepad!
Hooray for WASD users!

-The tutorial now updates to let you know what controls you have changed!

-You can now scroll up and down in the Level Select along with being able to scroll left or right.

Bug fixes

-Fixed a bug that causes the game to crash when you press select in the pause menu with the gamepad.

-Fixed a bug where you couldn't escape from the cutscenes using the gamepad with start.

notes.title: Patch for February 16th, 2020
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where you would be sent to the wrong level if you selected level 30 in the Level Select.

-Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow you to pass through Boss 3.

More updates coming soon!
